public.text: The four entry points are primarily classified by existing digital infrastructure. They give less attention to governance maturity, workforce capacity, legal readiness, fiscal space, decentralisation, connectivity, security, and conflict or emergency conditions.
public.suggestedRevision: Add these as dimensions that modify the recommended pathway, even where two countries appear to share the same infrastructure entry point.
